manifest.configuration_1: Install and authenticate the gh CLI on the gateway host, add a repository, then choose the review model, reasoning effort, and concurrency in Settings.
manifest.description: Deep-reviews GitHub pull requests and tells you which changes actually deserve your attention. Each pull request is reviewed in its own isolated agent session that covers every changed file, weighted by how much blast radius it carries, and rolled up into a prioritized Focus Report. Findings are read in the app and staged as a draft GitHub review only when you publish them or turn on automatic posting, and the reviewer keeps learning your repository's real standards from shipped fixes and past review comments.
manifest.highlight_1: Focus Report ranks changes by blast radius so the risky files get read first
manifest.highlight_2: One isolated agent session per pull request, so findings never bleed between reviews
manifest.highlight_3: Reviews are read in the app — nothing is posted to your pull request unless you ask
manifest.highlight_4: Learns per-repository from shipped fixes, review comments, and design discussions
manifest.highlight_5: Reviews GitHub pull requests; needs an authenticated `gh` CLI on the gateway host
manifest.use_case_1: Review one or many GitHub pull requests by risk, inspect focused findings, and stage only the comments worth publishing.
